description:
Explore the Holy Land like never before. From Nazareth and Bethlehem to Jerusalem’s sacred sites, from the Dead Sea to Tel Aviv and Gaza — this is a journey across millennia. We follow the path of Jesus, ancient empires, crusaders, and modern nations, uncovering how their stories shaped today’s conflicts and hopes for peace.
